GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 676.3 (21 Dec 45) CCS
(SCAPIN - 480)
21 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Additional Radio Facilities Required by the Occupation Forces.
1. The Japanese Government will provide and operate facilities for the Japanese terminal of one radio-telegram circuit between Tokyo and Manila, Philippine Islands for the purpose of carrying official traffic of the Occupation Forces.
2. Informal arrangements were made by this headquarters with the Japanese Board of Communications on 13 December 1945 and since 0300, 19 December 1945 the International Telecommunications Company has been providing this service from its Oyama transmitting station with the call signs, frequencies, and power listed below which are temporarily authorized for this service:
JNR-5 15,945kc 5KW
JNR-2 7,725kc 5KW
3. This memorandum confirms the informal arrangements mentioned in paragraph two.
4. The Japanese Government is directed to continue furnishing the facilities outlined above for as long a period of time as deemed necessary th this headquarters.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
